sessionid.title: Instagram sessionid Cookie
sessionid.description: The 'sessionid' cookie from your logged-in Instagram session in your browser. Used to authenticate requests and bypass Instagram login walls.

cookies.title: Full Cookies String (Optional)
cookies.description: Optional full cookies header string from your browser (e.g. sessionid=...; ds_user_id=...; csrftoken=...).

keyword.title: Search Keyword
keyword.description: Keyword to search in Instagram explore search (e.g. 'wisata jember').

maxPosts.title: Max Posts per Query
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of post/reel links to collect for each hashtag or keyword (disarankan 5-10 agar run selesai < 1m 20d).

scrollCount.title: Scroll Iterations
scrollCount.description: Berapa kali scraper men-scroll halaman ke bawah untuk memuat postingan baru.

scrapeDetails.title: Scrape Post Details (Likes, Comments, Views, Caption)
scrapeDetails.description: If enabled, visits each post to extract caption, likes, comments, views, author, and timestamp.

skipSeenPosts.title: Skip Already Scraped Posts
skipSeenPosts.description: If enabled, posts that were already scraped in previous runs will be skipped automatically to avoid duplicate data.

repeatCount.title: Jumlah Siklus Run (Repeat Cycles)
repeatCount.description: Berapa kali scraper mengulang siklus dalam satu kali run. Jika memakai Apify Scheduler, gunakan 1 (karena scheduler yang menjalankan berkala).

delayBetweenRunsSec.title: Jeda Antar Siklus (Detik)
delayBetweenRunsSec.description: Jeda waktu tunggu (detik) antara satu siklus selesai ke siklus berikutnya jika repeatCount > 1.

maxRunTimeSecs.title: Batas Maksimal Durasi Run (Detik)
maxRunTimeSecs.description: Batas waktu maksimal per run (default: 70 detik, maks: 75 detik) untuk menjamin run selalu selesai di bawah 1 menit 20 detik.
